versions.changelog:
## v1.0.3– Security Hardening

- Restricted API requests to approved Microsoft Graph hosts and Intune/Entra endpoint areas.
- Prevented bearer tokens from being printed to stdout.
- Added enforced confirmation flags for write operations.
- Tier 3 actions now require the exact confirmed object name.
- Preserved strict read-only mode for all non-GET requests.
- Improved token-cache permissions and secret handling.
- Fixed compatibility with macOS Bash 3.2.
- Corrected license ownership information.
- Updated security documentation and usage examples.

## openclaw-intune-skill v1.0.2 – Major Redesign
- Complete overhaul of skill structure and documentation for clarity and scalability.
- Added extensive reference files covering all core management domains (devices, policies, apps, reporting, workflows, troubleshooting, platform).
- Introduced robust safety tier system for all write operations and clarified confirmation rules.
- Added scripts for standardized Graph API access, authentication, and token handling.
- Enhanced support for multi-tenant setups and new environment variable options.
- Improved error explanation guidelines and detailed routing instructions for use cases.
Added required environment variable declarations (INTUNE_TENANT_ID, INTUNE_CLIENT_ID, INTUNE_CLIENT_SECRET) to fix security flag. Added homepage link.

Initial release: Enables comprehensive Microsoft Intune management via Graph API.

- Complete coverage for device, app, policy, compliance, user, group, reporting, Autopilot, PowerShell script management, and all remote device actions.
- Detailed authentication requirements and guidance, including OAuth 2.0 flow and required permissions.
- Strict safety and confirmation protocols for sensitive actions (e.g., wipe, retire, delete, policy changes).
- Clear instructions for presenting data in readable formats with error-handling in simple German.
- Organized API endpoint references for all major Intune management scenarios.
